manifest.claim: Retrospective exploratory study, not pristine out-of-sample or live performance

method.seed_uncertainty: Sample SD across training seeds; not independent market histories
method.bootstrap_unit: one aligned market date, after averaging seed daily returns
method.equity_curve: arithmetic mean of initial-1 NAV paths; not compounded mean daily returns
method.cash_weight: Cash plus dividend receivables, divided by total NAV
method.folds: Independent starting NAV=1; never concatenate fold returns
method.selection: Read frozen validation selection; no ranking or selection by test results
